collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2005 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2005 to 2013 (W221) requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
